theme_basis: Four publicly documented Dartmouth Cancer Center research programs
disclaimer: Independent public template catalog inspired by published Dartmouth research themes. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorized by Dartmouth Cancer Center. No Dartmouth data or code included.

programs.name: Translational Engineering in Cancer
themes: Cellular and molecular detection and contrast

deployables.title: Cancer incidence and rural survivorship
deployables.expected_contract: SEER*Stat export; case-count and time/region contracts
deployables.candidate_analysis: Incidence rate and age adjustment after denominator verification
deployables.candidate_figures: Rates with confidence intervals; stratified trends
deployables.implementation_status: priority reference schema adapter not yet implemented

deployables.title: Cancer screening utilization and equity
deployables.expected_contract: Annual codebook, weights, strata, PSUs, question eligibility
deployables.candidate_analysis: Design-based weighted screening comparisons and nonresponse audit
deployables.candidate_figures: Weighted dot and interval plots; geographic stratifications

deployables.title: Environmental exposures and potential cancer risk factors
deployables.expected_contract: Cycle-specific component codebooks, linkage by SEQN and sub-sample weights
deployables.candidate_analysis: Exposure distributions; survey-adjusted association after confounder review
deployables.candidate_figures: Distribution and interval plots; exposure gradients
deployables.implementation_status: priority reference schema adapter not yet implemented

deployables.title: Care disparities and comparative effectiveness
deployables.expected_contract: Registry-released variables and data-use restrictions; treatment limitations
deployables.candidate_analysis: Stratified outcomes; appropriate survival or comparison models after design review
deployables.candidate_figures: Survival and forest plots with uncertainty

deployables.title: Cancer mutations and molecular networks
deployables.expected_contract: Project, case, sample, aliquot, files and variant types; stable joins
deployables.candidate_analysis: Mutation recurrence or pathway enrichment with batch and sample-level safeguards
deployables.candidate_figures: Oncoplot; annotation heatmap; effect and network panels
deployables.implementation_status: priority reference schema adapter not yet implemented

deployables.title: Bulk tumor transcriptomics and differential expression
deployables.expected_contract: GSE/GSM/GPL relations, count versus normalized intensity, biological replicates
deployables.candidate_analysis: RNA-seq count design with DESeq2 OR processed intensity with limma; never mix scale types
deployables.candidate_figures: QC heatmap; volcano; uncertainty-aware effect forest
deployables.implementation_status: priority reference schema adapter not yet implemented

deployables.title: Tumor proteogenomic profiling
deployables.expected_contract: Study, aliquot, tumor type and processing/QC metadata; cross-assay mapping
deployables.candidate_analysis: Paired analyte association, molecular pathway analysis with batch sensitivity

deployables.title: Tumor microenvironment gene-expression patterns
deployables.expected_contract: Bulk expression, biospecimen identities and tumor attributes; cell composition uncertain
deployables.candidate_analysis: Descriptive immune-associated gene sets, batch checks; no inferred therapy response without labels

deployables.title: Immune single-cell experiment metadata
deployables.source_name: NCBI GEO series and sample metadata
deployables.expected_contract: Study/subject/sample/cell nesting, assay platform and sample clustering; missing cell annotations
deployables.analysis_unit: cell nested in sample and subject
deployables.candidate_analysis: Single-cell QC and pseudobulk planning; avoid cell-level pseudoreplication
deployables.candidate_figures: UMAP; cell proportion uncertainty and QC plots

deployables.title: Immunotherapy trial landscape
deployables.expected_contract: NCT identifier, recruitment status, arms/interventions, conditions and posted outcomes
deployables.candidate_analysis: Trial landscape metadata only; no patient-level treatment efficacy estimates
deployables.candidate_figures: Trial timelines; enrollment and intervention summaries

deployables.title: Cancer CT/MRI imaging cohorts
deployables.expected_contract: DICOM series/study/patient IDs, modality, acquisition and collection licenses
deployables.candidate_analysis: Metadata QC, reference standard review and patient-level split planning
deployables.candidate_figures: Imaging QC mosaic; lesion annotation and reader variability
deployables.implementation_status: priority reference schema adapter not yet implemented

deployables.title: Cancer imaging AI benchmarking
deployables.expected_contract: Annotation provenance, patient-ID dedup, image-level leakage and independent test sets
deployables.analysis_unit: patient with linked scans and labels
deployables.candidate_analysis: Patient-level partitioning, calibration, external testing and reference-standard review

deployables.title: Radiotherapy structure and dose quality
deployables.expected_contract: Collection-by-collection presence of RTSTRUCT/RTDOSE/CT and linkage
deployables.candidate_analysis: RTSTRUCT/dose metadata checks; dose-volume summaries only when verified

deployables.title: Optical and molecular contrast research
deployables.expected_contract: No common universal dictionary; requires chosen study and calibration metadata
deployables.candidate_analysis: Only synthetic optical signal QC until a verified study dataset is selected

caution: Existing NHANES 2017–2018 generic schema pilot in a separate Study Pack may support a related exposure workflow; it does not constitute a cancer-specific validated analysis.
